messages:
erin: quick spot-check request — PR #46812 is a small routing/fallback tweak that affects runtime cache fallthrough. tests pass in CI but we need runtime + infra + security eyes before the Monday merge window. can someone from each team take a look? :pray:
sasha: i can review the runtime changes. is there a short diff or config snippet i should focus on?
alex: tagging infra + security for visibility. alex (platform): can we gate merge until all three have LGTM + canary scheduled? ideally merge Mon 10:30am PT.
ci-bot: CI: all checks passed (unit, integration). build 46812 succeeded. :white_check_mark:
 erin: thanks — main things: small fallback policy change (adds a route to try-legacy if model-cache miss), and a TTL tweak for prefetched keys. diff is tiny, pasted below:
```
service/orch/routing.go:+12 -5  // adds legacy fallback route
service/cache/config.yaml: fallback_ttl: 30s -> 45s
```
shouldn't affect auth or KMS; no new config secrets.
maria: i'll eyeball infra implications — does the fallback route change trigger additional egress or cross-region calls? if so we should validate peak QPS.
erin: no cross-region calls, route stays local. fallback just switches to an existing local variant. qps not expected to increase.
sam: security: i'll check auth flows and make sure the fallback doesn't bypass any token validation. quick question: is the legacy variant using the same key encryption path (KMS) or a plaintext cache?
erin: legacy uses same KMS-backed cache; no plaintext. we ran a local smoke that validated key unwrap.
sasha: took a quick pass — runtime-wise looks fine. two nit comments inline about metrics naming. i'll post a tiny follow-up patch if you prefer. will do deeper canary smoke tomorrow morning.
alex: from platform side i approve scheduling the canary. i'll own the canary run at 10:30am PT Monday and coordinate rollback if needed. please add the canary tag in the PR description so infra monitoring picks it up.
maria: infra quick note — verify that evictor SLOs aren't affected by the TTL bump. i'm good to approve if we keep canary low traffic (10%). LGTM pending that.
sam: security :eyes: i ran the token flow locally, added a small comment recommending an explicit assertion on key id presence; small change, then i'm good to LGTM.
erin: thanks all — i'll push a tiny followup to assert key id and add canary tag to PR description. pinging back once pushed. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: CI: new build queued for PR #46812 after push.
erin: pushed. tiny assert added and description updated with `canary=10% owner=alex`. can everyone re-check when you have a sec?
sasha: rechecked, comments addressed. LGTM from runtime.
maria: LGTM infra.
sam: LGTM security after the assert.
erin: awesome — thanks team. alex, feel free to merge in the Monday window. i'll be on-call during canary in case of fallout. :raised_hands:
